issues.body_excerpt: The Qoder and Qoder CN segments token reader re-reads a static incomplete tail on every lookup. A 32 MiB synthetic line without a newline was read in full on two consecutive lookups, with 527 MiB of cumulative Buffer.concat input bytes per lookup and no token events.

issues.title: fix(qoder-work): keep idle SDK checkpoints clean
